_comment: Single source of truth for every model: used by scripts/download_models.py and by the editor's model picker. 'backend' says how the editor runs it; 'weights-only' entries are downloaded for later phone/other testing but cannot run in the editor.

models.name: EdgeTAM · phone ONNX int8
models.phone_speed: Real-time needs the phone NPU/GPU (16 FPS iPhone 15 Pro Max). CPU-only ≈ 1 FPS.
models.notes: The exported phone pipeline (4 ONNX graphs + numpy loop) running on CPU, 4 threads, like a phone. int8 weights (phone CPU / XNNPACK). Same masks as PyTorch (IoU 0.998). Generated by scripts/export_edgetam_onnx.py.

models.name: EdgeTAM · phone ONNX fp16
models.phone_speed: Real-time needs the phone NPU/GPU (16 FPS iPhone 15 Pro Max). CPU-only ≈ 1 FPS.
models.notes: The exported phone pipeline (4 ONNX graphs + numpy loop) running on CPU, 4 threads, like a phone. fp16 (phone GPU/NPU: CoreML-style, NNAPI, QNN). Same masks (IoU 0.998). Slow on a PC CPU - no fp16 math there. Generated by scripts/export_edgetam_onnx.py.

models.name: EdgeTAM · phone ONNX fp32
models.phone_speed: Real-time needs the phone NPU/GPU (16 FPS iPhone 15 Pro Max). CPU-only ≈ 1 FPS.
models.notes: The exported phone pipeline (4 ONNX graphs + numpy loop) running on CPU, 4 threads, like a phone. fp32 reference export. Same masks as PyTorch (IoU 0.998). Generated by scripts/export_edgetam_onnx.py.

models.name: EdgeTAM
models.notes: Phone-sized SAM 2 (Meta, CVPR 2025). 16 FPS on iPhone 15 Pro Max. The recommended model for phones.
models.phone_speed: 16 FPS on iPhone 15 Pro Max (EdgeTAM paper)

models.name: SAM 2.1 Tiny
models.notes: Smallest official SAM 2.1. About 1 FPS on iPhone. Quality reference for phone models.
models.phone_speed: ~1 FPS on iPhone 15 Pro Max (EdgeTAM paper) - too slow for live

models.name: SAM 2.1 Small
models.notes: Official SAM 2.1 small.
models.phone_speed: Not usable on phones - desktop GPU reference

models.name: SAM 2.1 Base+
models.notes: Official SAM 2.1 base-plus.
models.phone_speed: Not usable on phones - desktop GPU reference

models.name: SAM 2.1 Large
models.notes: Best SAM 2.1 quality. Desktop/server only. Use it as the 'ground truth' when comparing phone models.
models.phone_speed: Not usable on phones - best-quality reference for Compare

models.name: SAM 3 (tracker)
models.notes: Meta SAM 3, used here as a click-and-track model. GATED: request access at https://huggingface.co/facebook/sam3 first. Needs ~4+ GB VRAM.
models.phone_speed: Server/desktop GPU only (~840M params)

models.name: EfficientTAM Ti
models.notes: EfficientTAM tiny (ICCV 2025). ~10 FPS reported on iPhone 15 Pro Max.
models.phone_speed: ~10 FPS on iPhone 15 Pro Max (EfficientTAM paper)

models.name: EfficientTAM Ti/1
models.notes: EfficientTAM tiny with efficient cross-attention memory (variant 1).
models.phone_speed: Faster than Ti (efficient memory); no separate phone number published

models.name: EfficientTAM Ti/2
models.notes: EfficientTAM tiny with efficient cross-attention memory (variant 2, fastest).
models.phone_speed: Fastest Ti variant (efficient memory); no separate phone number published

models.name: EfficientTAM Ti 512px
models.notes: EfficientTAM tiny at 512x512 input. Much faster, lower detail.
models.phone_speed: Faster than Ti (512 px input, less detail); no phone number published

models.name: EfficientTAM S
models.notes: EfficientTAM small. SA-V test 74.5 J&F (close to SAM 2). Best quality of the phone-class models, but slow on phones.
models.phone_speed: ~1 FPS on iPhone 15 (1010 ms/frame, paper) - recorded video only

models.name: EfficientTAM S/1
models.notes: EfficientTAM small, efficient memory variant 1.
models.phone_speed: ~2 FPS class on iPhone 15 (efficient memory) - recorded video only

models.name: EfficientTAM S/2
models.notes: EfficientTAM small, efficient memory variant 2 (SA-V test 74.0, ~450 ms/frame on iPhone 15).
models.phone_speed: ~2.2 FPS on iPhone 15 (450 ms/frame, paper) - recorded video only

models.name: EfficientTAM S 512px
models.notes: EfficientTAM small at 512x512 input.
models.phone_speed: Faster than S (512 px input); no phone number published

models.name: EdgeTAM original checkpoint (.pt)
models.notes: Meta's original PyTorch checkpoint for github.com/facebookresearch/EdgeTAM (export_to_coreml.py uses it).
models.phone_speed: Source checkpoint for phone exports

models.name: EdgeTAM ONNX (fp32/fp16/int8/q4)
models.notes: Image encoder + prompt/mask decoder in ONNX, many quantizations. Image-only (no video memory). For ONNX Runtime Mobile / Web.
models.phone_speed: Android/Web ONNX - image parts only (no tracking memory)

models.name: EdgeTAM ExecuTorch (.pte)
models.notes: Encoder + decoder as ExecuTorch programs (XNNPACK fp32/fp16 for Android, CoreML delegate for iOS). Image-only parts.
models.phone_speed: Android XNNPACK / iOS - image parts only (no tracking memory)

models.name: EdgeTAM CoreML Video (4 packages)
models.notes: Community full-video CoreML port: ImageEncoder, Initializer, MemoryEncoder, Propagator. iOS 18+. Runs on iPhone/Mac only.
models.phone_speed: iPhone CoreML with tracking memory - ~10 FPS demo (community)

models.name: SAM 2.1 original checkpoints (.pt, all sizes)
models.notes: Original checkpoints for github.com/facebookresearch/sam2 (needed for some CoreML/ONNX export tools).
models.phone_speed: Original SAM 2.1 checkpoints for Meta's repo / export tools

models.name: SAM 3.1 (multiplex)
models.notes: Meta SAM 3.1 original checkpoint (multi-object multiplex). GATED. Runs with Meta's sam3 repo on a big GPU, not in this editor.
models.phone_speed: Server GPU only

models.name: EfficientSAM3 (EV-M / RV-M / TV-M)
models.notes: Distilled SAM 3 (text + click prompts). Upstream has only released IMAGE models so far (the video memory stage is still on their to-do list), so the editor can't track with it yet.
models.phone_speed: Distilled SAM 3 for edge - image only, no tracking released yet

models.name: EfficientSAM3 every variant (~100 GB)
models.notes: All stage-1 / LiteText / SAM3.1-lite image variants. Only downloaded with --include-huge.
models.phone_speed: Image-only variants

models.name: TinySAM 2
models.notes: Paper only (arXiv 2605.18013, May 2026). No public code or weights found as of 2026-10-20.
models.phone_speed: Paper only - no weights

models.name: EdgeTAM for Snapdragon (Qualcomm AI Hub)
models.notes: Compiled per phone on Qualcomm AI Hub: pip install qai-hub-models, then python -m qai_hub_models.models.edgetam.export (needs a free AI Hub account/token).
models.phone_speed: Snapdragon NPU build via Qualcomm AI Hub

phone-onnx.label: Phone pipeline (ONNX)
phone-onnx.desc: The exact exported phone model + per-frame loop, run on CPU like a phone. Shows the quality you would ship. CPU speed is a worst case: phones use the NPU/GPU.

phone-realtime.label: Phone · real-time
phone-realtime.desc: Small enough to track live on a phone (≈10+ FPS). Use these for the app.

phone-slow.label: Phone · slow
phone-slow.desc: Runs on a phone but ~1-4 FPS: only for processing recorded video.

phone-image.label: Phone · image only
phone-image.desc: Edge-sized, but can't track across frames yet.

phone-file.label: Phone file
phone-file.desc: Converted files for phone apps (CoreML / ONNX / ExecuTorch).

desktop.label: Desktop only
desktop.desc: Too big for phones. Only as a quality reference to measure what the phone models lose.
